QuestInfo.name: What Did You Do Now
QuestInfo.0: Moonbeam seems upset about something. Maybe she's mad about not getting a gift, too. Talk to her.
QuestInfo.1: Moonbeam saw your wounds from getting the mouse tails, and stormed off. What did you do wrong? Follow her.
QuestInfo.2: Moonbeam was worried about you! She gave you her guardian spirit, saying you should be more careful. You have a more powerful spirit now, but what about Moonbeam?\r\n\r\n#rTip: Fox Marbles can be purchased from the Secondary Weapon Seller#k
QuestInfo.rewardSummary: #Wbasic#\r\n#fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 1800\r\nCan proceed to Way of the Fox (Lv. 20 or higher)
